title: Integer extension maps determined by their unit image
statement: Let X be a topological space, F an abelian sheaf, and U an open of X. Let E_U be the extension by zero to X of the constant integer sheaf on U [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let e_U in E_U(U) be the canonical unit section obtained by applying the constant-presheaf sheafification unit to integer one and the canonical extension section. The evaluation map Hom(E_U,F) → F(U), f ↦ f_U(e_U), is injective. No nonempty, compactness or connectedness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 00A5 (extension by zero adjunction); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00A5; integer generators used in Cohomology, Lemma 0A38, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: For x in U, the integer multiples of the canonical unit germ exhaust the source stalk by the integer-germ coordinates theorem. Naturality and additivity imply that two maps with the same unit image agree on this stalk.

For x outside U the source stalk is zero by extension-by-zero stalks, so the two stalk maps agree there as well. Apply Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext to images of arbitrary sections and then additive, natural-transformation and sheaf-map extensionality.

proof_origin.place: Extension-by-zero adjunction, specialized to constant integers; explicit unit compatibility as used in 0A38.

theorem abelianIntegerExtension_unit_injective
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (F : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) (U : Opens X) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : (abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⟶ F ↦
      f.hom.app (op U) (abelianOpenExtensionSection U
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) U le_rfl
        ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))ᵒᵖ).obj
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
          (op ((Opens.map U.inclusion').obj U)) (ULift.up 1))))
